title: Cold-Brew Cider
ldInstructionsRaw: Shake all of the ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled glass with no ice. Topped with an orange peel.

Spiced Citrus Syrup:
1½ cups orange juice
2½ cups water
2 cups brown sugar
3 grams whole clove
3 cinnamon sticks
2 grams nutmeg
5 grams cinnamon
Half of an orange, juiced & sliced
Boil ingredients together for 10 minutes and strain. Store syrup in the refrigerator when not in use.
